types.name: AssetConfig
docs: Per-collateral reserve configuration. PDA seeds: `["token_config", vault_config, underlying_mint]`.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: Underlying SPL mint (USDC, USDT, wBTC, …); precision stored at registration.

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: `underlying_mint.decimals` snapshot (1..=18).

fields.name: treasury_vault
docs: Protocol yield vault (PDA). Not part of wrapped token backing.

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Cumulative underlying deposited via `wrap` (underlying token atoms).

fields.name: total_wrapped_minted
docs: Cumulative wrapped token minted from this pool (wrapped token atoms).

fields.name: total_redemptions
docs: Cumulative wrapped token burned via `unwrap` against this pool (wrapped token atoms).

fields.name: mint_haircut_bps
docs: Bps discount on wrapped token minted per unit underlying (200 = mint 0.98 wStable per 1 USDT).

fields.name: redemption_haircut_bps
docs: Bps discount on underlying paid per unit wrapped token burned.

fields.name: mint_cap
docs: Max outstanding wrapped token liability (`total_wrapped_minted - total_redemptions`). 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: exposure_cap
docs: Alias exposure cap in wrapped token atoms for governance dashboards. 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: min_liquidity_target
docs: Policy hint: target free-vault liquidity for redemption UX.

types.name: KLendConfig
docs: Kamino KLend integration for a registered asset. PDA seeds: `["klend_config", asset_config]`.

fields.name: total_liquidity_in_klend
docs: USDC-denominated principal deployed to KLend for this asset.

fields.name: authority
docs: Immutable creator key used in PDA seeds. Never changes after init.

fields.name: admin
docs: Mutable operational admin. Can be transferred via two-step process.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Pending admin for two-step authority transfer. Default means no pending transfer.

fields.name: wrapped_decimals
docs: Decimal precision of `wrapped_mint` (fixed at initialize).

fields.name: total_stable_deposited
docs: Global wrapped token liability counter (wraps − unwraps).

fields.name: flash_mint_enabled
docs: Reserved for optional `flash-mint` feature; unused in shipped build.

fields.name: flash_mint_fee_bps
docs: Reserved for optional `flash-mint` feature; unused in shipped build.

fields.name: flash_mint_max_amount
docs: Reserved for optional `flash-mint` feature; unused in shipped build.

fields.name: flash_mint_fee_receiver
docs: Reserved for optional `flash-mint` feature; unused in shipped build.

fields.name: pending_mint_authority
docs: Pending destination for two-step mint authority transfer. Default means no pending transfer.

fields.name: mint_authority_transferred
docs: When true, SPL mint authority has left this vault and `wrap` is permanently disabled.
